section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the multifaceted construct of body image, distinguishing between negative and positive body image and their unique relationships with other variables. It highlights the limited research on interoception (processing of internal bodily sensations) in relation to body image, particularly positive body image. Several cited studies (Emanuelsen et al., Ainley & Tsakiris, Duschek et al., Daubenmier, Oswald et al.) are mentioned, providing details on sample sizes, countries, and participant types, but no specific study within this paper is described.
